decisions.reason: A door lever handle family close to the core range costs little to carry once tooled and still holds option value as a system family, although the firm has many design options and has already pruned similar launches (A, D, E).

This handle design remained on the website in 2019 while sibling designs were dropped, which suggests it survived the early screening, and its low carrying cost does not justify dropping it without negative evidence.

The electronic access system with its distinctive light technology fits the strategic move toward digital building organization, its uncertainty about value is still high, and it is a scarce growth option, so keeping it is worth more than the carrying cost.
